text.p: Here are the highlights of stories in the Danish press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
--Repairing the damage caused by floods in central Europe represents a huge business opportunity for Danish engineering and construction firms.
--Brewery and turkey producer Harboe produced record profits in 1996/97 of 37 million crowns.
--Growth in Danish new business startups was one percent in 1995, the lowest rate among the Nordic countries.
--More than 100,000 Danes use their home computers to carry out banking transactions.
--Greenlandic state-owned shipping company Royal Arctic is to seek a stock exchange listing.
--BG Bank is offering mortgages of up to 110 percent of the property value, in an attempt to break into the home loan market after its split with mortgage lender Nykredit.
--Pension reform is unlikely before the September 1998 general election. REUTERS
